Declared product lines: Electrosurgical Generators/Units (Cresta series, EPMD brand), Operation Theatre Lights (Prism Celesta, Constella with UniOptix), Operation Theatre Tables, Endoscopic Imaging Systems (VIX Intelligent Vision Platform, SpectraSure light sources), 'OR Infinity' complete OR audio-visual integration hub, plus accessories and 'modular OT solutions'. Certifications claimed on site: ISO 13485, CE, ISO 9001, ICMED 13485, CDSCO, FDA — заявлено, не подтверждено (no certificate numbers or registry links on the pages read).

comment: HS 901890 is only partially correct. It fits the electro-surgical generators/cautery and part of the endoscopic imaging line, but the declared single code does not cover the bulk of the catalogue: operation theatre lights (heading 9405 — surgical lamps/LED luminaires), operation theatre tables (heading 9402 — medical/surgical furniture), and OR-integration audio-visual hubs (8528/8543 territory). So the declaration is a one-code simplification of a multi-line OT-equipment portfolio: match_status = partial, not wrong — the company keeps 901890 as its main code and should add 9405, 9402 and 8528/8543 lines for the lighting, table and AV-hub products. Industry_claimed 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification: the actual business is medical/surgical equipment and OT infrastructure (electro-medical + medical furniture + lighting), not IT/electronics, even though the OR-integration product has an AV/IT component. Trader signs: explicit 'we distribute', 'longest-standing partner of EPMD', 'we don't just distribute... we build it into a brand' — a distribution/branding model, so origin of manufacture for the ESU line is EPMD, not Matrix. Product lines missing from the declaration: OT lights, OT tables, OR Infinity integration hub, modular OT projects, accessories/spares. No customs line was available to me in this task, therefore every product claim above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the site is the only source; no shipment or invoice record was checked. No PAN/CIN, revenue or export volume researched per role scope (null).
